cues.en: I think they basically thought we were naive greenies from the city.
cues.zh: 我想他们基本上觉得我们是从城里来的天真环保分子。

cues.en: I'm sure they thought that we had come here with all these ideas, and within a year or two, we'd find it was all just too hard and it wasn't happening and we'd go again.
cues.zh: 我敢肯定，他们以为我们带着这些想法来到这里，一两年内就会发现太难、根本行不通，然后就会离开。

cues.en: Here we are thirty one years later.
cues.zh: 三十一年后的今天，我们还在这里。

cues.en: And it's interesting because I don't think there's a single farmer around us who may not be completely
cues.zh: 有意思的是，我觉得我们周围没有一个农民会不完全

cues.en: believing what we're doing, but I don't think there's a single farmer who's not backing Hinawai now.
cues.zh: 相信我们做的事；但我觉得现在没有一个农民不支持Hinawai。

cues.en: I think it was in about October
cues.zh: 我想大概是在十月

cues.en: we wrote an article for the local newspaper, which is called the Akaroa Mail.
cues.zh: 我们给当地报纸《Akaroa Mail》写了一篇文章。

cues.en: I just thought we'd let the community know what we were doing here.
cues.zh: 我只是想让大家知道我们在这里做什么。

cues.en: It
cues.zh: 这

cues.en: was interesting because we wrote this article, and then a few weeks later we got this amazing response from one of the farmers.
cues.zh: 很有意思，因为我们写了这篇文章，几周后，一位农民给了我们一个非常棒的回应。

cues.en: I can read you that article if you like.
cues.zh: 如果你愿意，我可以把那篇文章读给你听。

cues.en: Was a much longer article than this, but I said in the article, my secret dream is that one day a whole catchment from summit crest to sea, from snow tussock to nickel palm, from Somalia to Mamakoo tree fern and yellow eyed penguins could be set aside for nature to reassert her original covering.
cues.zh: 那篇文章比这长得多，但我在文章里说，我暗藏的梦想是：有一天，从山顶到大海的整个集水区，从雪丛草到尼考棕榈，从Somalia到Mamakoo树蕨和黄眼企鹅，都能被留出来，让自然重新恢复它原本的植被。

cues.en: That's what I said in the article. And then,
cues.zh: 这就是我在文章里说的。然后，

cues.en: this is a response from one of the farmers. Again, I'm only reading the last two paragraphs.
cues.zh: 这是一位农民的回应。再说一次，我只读最后两段。

cues.en: This is a farmer who lived in the next valley on a gorse infested farm, which he'd been trying to fight all his life. And he said, I am all for saving patches of bush,
cues.zh: 这位农民住在隔壁山谷一个长满金雀花的农场里，他一辈子都在跟金雀花斗争。他说，我完全赞成保留一片片原生林，

cues.en: but the thought of starting from scratch on land that is clear enough to be used productively
cues.zh: 但一想到要在已经清理干净、足以用于生产的土地上从零开始

cues.en: frankly appalls me.
cues.zh: 坦白说，这让我很震惊。

cues.en: As for shutting up a whole valley, heaven help us from fools and dreamers.
cues.zh: 至于把整个山谷封闭起来，愿上天保佑我们远离傻瓜和空想家。

cues.en: I love that. I regard that as a as a great compliment. Because we need a few more fools and dreamers in the world, I think.
cues.zh: 我很喜欢这句话。我把它视为极大的赞美。因为我觉得，这个世界需要再多一些傻瓜和梦想家。

cues.en: So here we are on Hinawa Reserve. We were in the Southeast Corner of Banks Peninsula, which is on the East Coast Of The South Island jutting out into the Pacific.
cues.zh: 我们现在在 Hinawa 保护区。这里是班克斯半岛的东南角，半岛位于南岛东海岸，伸入太平洋。

cues.en: The amazing thing about New Zealand, I think, is how recently people got here across the Tasman Sea sixty thousand years ago when the aboriginal people reached Australia,
cues.zh: 我觉得新西兰令人惊叹的一点是，人类跨过塔斯曼海来到这里的时间其实很近——六万年前原住民到达了澳大利亚，

cues.en: but only about eight hundred years ago until amazing Polynesian voyages
cues.zh: 但仅仅大约八百年前，非凡的波利尼西亚航海者

cues.en: finally hit the biggest landmass in Polynesia and settled here.
cues.zh: 终于抵达波利尼西亚最大的陆地，并在这里定居下来。

cues.en: The first named group we know of is called Waitaha.
cues.zh: 我们知道的最早的有名字的群体叫 Waitaha。

cues.en: Another wave of settlement came called Ngati Mamoi from the North Island.
cues.zh: 另一波定居者叫 Ngati Mamoi，从北岛而来。

cues.en: And then in about 1700,
cues.zh: 然后大约在 1700 年，

cues.en: the Ngai Tahu or Kai Tahu came south southwards from the North Island again.
cues.zh: Ngai Tahu，也就是 Kai Tahu，再次从北岛南下。

cues.en: Then, of course, Pakeha came. Pakeha, the European settlers from the other side of the planet,
cues.zh: 然后当然，Pakeha 来了。Pakeha 就是来自地球另一边的欧洲定居者，

cues.en: they arrived here.
cues.zh: 他们来到了这里。

cues.en: All these waves of human settlement had a huge impact ecologically as you can imagine. At the beginning, Banks Peninsula was forested from side to side and from top to bottom, an ancient old forest.
cues.zh: 你可以想象，所有这些人类定居浪潮都产生了巨大的生态影响。起初，班克斯半岛从这一头到那一头、从山顶到山脚都是森林，是一片古老的原始森林。

cues.en: Both Maori and European settlement had a huge impact on the forest. So by 1900,
cues.zh: 毛利人和欧洲人的定居都对森林造成了巨大影响。所以到 1900 年，

cues.en: less than 1%
cues.zh: 不到 1%

cues.en: of the old growth forest was left.
cues.zh: 的原始森林留存了下来。

cues.en: Hinawa Reserve, it's a result of the Morris White Native Forest Trust.
cues.zh: Hinawa Reserve，这是 Morris White 原生森林信托的成果。

cues.en: We look after 1,500
cues.zh: 我们照看着 1,500

cues.en: hectares. That's quite a big area, several catchments.
cues.zh: 公顷。那是相当大的区域，有好几个集水区。

cues.en: The whole idea was to make it possible for nature to speed up the regeneration of the native forest and restore the native biodiversity as much as is possible because we've lost some things altogether.
cues.zh: 整个想法是让大自然能够加速原生森林的再生，尽可能恢复原生生物多样性，因为有些东西我们已经彻底失去了。

cues.en: Conservation was our first goal, to restore the biodiversity on which we're all completely dependent and we sometimes forget that. Some people say, well, why are you restoring the forest? In a way, saying why are you doing it is like saying why should you love your mother? That sort parallel.
cues.zh: 保护是我们的首要目标，恢复我们所有人都完全依赖的生物多样性，而我们有时会忘记这一点。有人说，那你为什么要恢复森林？某种程度上，问为什么这么做，就像问为什么要爱你的母亲？差不多这个意思。

cues.en: We're totally, totally dependent on vegetation and the wildlife that supports our own lives. We wouldn't be there if it wasn't for plants and vegetation and animals and birds and so on.
cues.zh: 我们完全、完全依赖植被和野生动物来支撑我们自己的生活。如果没有植物、植被、动物和鸟类等等，我们就不会存在。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: our prime goal is conservation, but from the very beginning we decided that people would be able to come here freely, whenever they wanted, without asking, could just come and walk our tracks. And there's many, many kilometers of walking tracks now.
cues.zh: 我们的首要目标是保护，但从一开始我们就决定，人们可以随时自由地来这里，不用打招呼，直接来走我们的步道。现在有好多好多公里的步道了。

cues.en: So it's really like a little mini national park right on the doorstep of Akaroa itself.
cues.zh: 所以它就像一个小型国家公园，就在 Akaroa 的家门口。

cues.en: So there's two centers of settlement, if you like.
cues.zh: 所以可以说有两个定居中心。

cues.en: The the house we're in now is my post earthquake house.
cues.zh: 我们现在待的这栋房子是我震后建的房子。

cues.en: Previously, lived in an older house just about a 100 meters away across to the east. And that was somewhat damaged in the big earthquakes of 2010
cues.zh: 以前住在一栋更老的房子里，往东大约 100 米远。那栋房子在 2010 年的大地震中受损了一些

cues.en: Andrew, who's been a trustee, came to work here with us several years ago. And he lives during the week in my old earthquake damaged house and goes home to his wife, Suzanne, in the weekends.
cues.zh: Andrew 一直担任受托人，几年前来这里和我们一起工作。工作日他住在我那栋被地震损坏的老房子里，周末回妻子 Suzanne 那里。

cues.en: And then Otanarito
cues.zh: 然后是 Otanarito

cues.en: Homestead, Paul and Tricia live down there, and it's about one hour's walk away. The next is on the power polar up edge. Oh. And there's a few of them, but I can't look at how many.
cues.zh: Homestead，Paul 和 Tricia 住在下面，走路大约一小时。下一个在电线杆上方边缘。哦。还有几个，但我数不清有多少。

cues.en: This is Hinaway Stream, the first crossing.
cues.zh: 这是 Hinaway Stream，第一个过溪点。

cues.en: This is permanent flow here. Even in the driest of drought years, we've never lost our flow in the largest streams. And it's amazing when you think of it because
cues.zh: 这里常年有水流。即使最干旱的年份，最大的溪流也从未断流。想想真很惊人，因为

cues.en: a lot of people think of Bank being a sort of an open, dry, grassy place, but this is really what Bank Peninsula is and was.
cues.zh: 很多人以为 Banks Peninsula 是一片开阔、干燥、长草的地方，但这才是 Banks Peninsula 真正的样子，过去也是。

cues.en: And the water is a very prominent part of it.
cues.zh: 水是其中非常突出的一部分。

cues.en: We just keep finding new waterfalls as we explore more. This is one of the first ones we found. It's right on the main track so everybody sees this. We put a little one minute track off to it. It's called Fuchsia Falls.
cues.zh: 我们越探索，就越不断发现新的瀑布。这是我们最早发现的之一。它就在主步道边，所以每个人都能看到。我们修了一条一分钟的小岔路通向它。它叫 Fuchsia Falls。

cues.en: It's only one of about 47
cues.zh: 它只是大约 47 个

cues.en: waterfalls
cues.zh: 瀑布

cues.en: across the whole of Hinawai that we've found so far in name.
cues.zh: 之一，遍布整个 Hinawai，是我们迄今发现并命名的。

cues.en: You can't meet Hugh and not
cues.zh: 你见到 Hugh，不可能不

cues.en: just like him.
cues.zh: 喜欢他。

cues.en: Hugh's the boss and he's the day to day manager of the reserve.
cues.zh: Hugh 是负责人，也是保护区的日常管理者。

cues.en: He gets up every day, he has the same routine, and he goes to work.
cues.zh: 他每天起床，按同样的作息，然后去上班。

cues.en: Work is harder.
cues.zh: 上班更辛苦。

cues.en: We don't use vehicles to get to work, so the work site might be two hours walk away.
cues.zh: 我们不用车辆上班，所以工作地点可能在步行两小时外。

cues.en: And so two hours after walking to work, you start work and you work all day and then you walk home for two hours. And when he gets home
cues.zh: 于是，步行两小时去上班后，你开始工作，干了一整天，然后又步行两小时回家。等他到家

cues.en: he'll have his path and have his dinner and from about 07:00 or 07:30 he's ready for his evening and so he sits at his table and he starts working
cues.zh: 他会走完自己的路，吃完晚饭，大约七点或七点半，他就准备好开始晚间的事了，于是坐在桌前，开始工作

cues.en: and he does all the paperwork involved with Hanawai
cues.zh: 他处理所有与Hanawai相关的文书工作

cues.en: He writes letters,
cues.zh: 他写信，

cues.en: he writes submissions,
cues.zh: 他写材料，

cues.en: he writes and he writes and he writes.
cues.zh: 他写了又写，写了又写。

cues.en: Then the next day he gets up and off he goes again.
cues.zh: 第二天他起床，又出发了。

cues.en: He's amazing, it's his life, It's his dream.
cues.zh: 他很了不起，这就是他的生活，他的梦想。

cues.en: I mean, this top here would get too difficult.
cues.zh: 我是说，这个山顶会变得太难爬了。

cues.en: From a very, very early age, I was walking on Banks Peninsula.
cues.zh: 从很小很小的时候起，我就在班克斯半岛上徒步。

cues.en: I remember getting very interested in bird life,
cues.zh: 我记得自己对鸟类生活产生了浓厚的兴趣，

cues.en: and I thought, oh, grow Banks Peninsula plants in the back garden of our family home.
cues.zh: 我想，哦，要在我们家后院种班克斯半岛的植物。

cues.en: I just got so fascinated by the way plants grew. Just everything about plants just completely caught my fancy.
cues.zh: 我就是对植物生长的方式如此着迷。关于植物的一切都完全吸引了我。

cues.en: It was interesting at university because I would had decided from the very beginning to do both arts and science.
cues.zh: 上大学时很有意思，因为我从一开始就决定文理双修。

cues.en: And it was Buffing I went on with really.
cues.zh: 后来我真正继续下去的是Buffing。

cues.en: So for several years I'd been tramping on a regular systematic grid pattern of sampling across Banks Peninsula, doing in much greater detail than never been done before, a detailed botanical look at the peninsula. And then as I was doing this, was thinking,
cues.zh: 所以几年来，我一直以定期的系统网格模式在班克斯半岛上采样徒步，对半岛进行比以往任何时候都更详细的植物学考察。在做这些的时候，我想，

cues.en: gosh, I know I thought it had been completely trashed, but there's so much still here,
cues.zh: 天哪，我知道我以为这里已经被彻底破坏了，但还有这么多东西留在这里，

cues.en: a lot of it coming back. So all this made me think, I'd love to look after a bit of this land and let this all happen.
cues.zh: 很多东西正在恢复。所以这一切让我想，我很想照看这片土地的一部分，让这一切自然发生。

cues.en: And amazingly, was introduced to this guy called Morris White. He'd set up a fund to purchase land for conservation purposes on Banks Peninsula.
cues.zh: 令人惊喜的是，有人把我介绍给了一位叫 Morris White 的人。他在 Banks Peninsula 设立了一笔基金，专门用来购买土地搞生态保护。

cues.en: He said, would you be interested in being involved? And I think I waited about half a nanosecond and said, yes.
cues.zh: 他问我：“你有兴趣参与吗？”我大概只犹豫了半纳秒，就回答：“好。”

cues.en: We started looking for land, and I kept my eyes sharp open. And on this particular bit of land, which was the original part of Hinawai, 109
cues.zh: 我们开始物色土地，我也时刻留心。看到这片土地时——也就是 Hinawai 最早的那片地，109

cues.en: hectares,
cues.zh: 公顷，

cues.en: I said to Morris, look, this is ideal. It's it's a reasonable size, but not huge.
cues.zh: 我对 Morris 说：“看，这块地太理想了。面积适中，不算太大。

cues.en: It's got old growth forest on it, so we can see what the end result would be of a regeneration program. And it's basically uneconomic
cues.zh: 上面有原生林，正好能让我们看到植被恢复计划的最终愿景。而且从经济上看它基本没什么价值，

cues.en: and marginal hill country, which really shouldn't really be farmed at all.
cues.zh: 属于边缘丘陵地带，本来就根本不该用来放牧耕种。”

cues.en: September 1987, we bought that land.
cues.zh: 1987年9月，我们买下了那块地。

cues.en: Four years later, it became hugely bigger because we had the opportunity to buy Old Tanarito Station, which was right next to us, and that made it 10 times bigger.
cues.zh: 四年后，面积大幅扩大，因为我们有机会买下了紧挨着我们的 Old Tanarito Station，这让整个保护区扩大了十倍。

cues.en: The local community was a bit suspicious about what we were doing, I have to say. All the farmers in the area
cues.zh: 不得不说，当地人对我们的做法多少有些怀疑。附近所有的农户

cues.en: thought he was a total nutter. When I first heard of the fact that Shoe and the trust were going to use gorse to help regenerate
cues.zh: 都觉得他彻底疯了。当我第一次听说 Shoe 和信托基金打算利用荆豆来帮助恢复

cues.en: the natives,
cues.zh: 本土植被时，

cues.en: I was a
cues.zh: 我其实也是

cues.en: sceptic of it.
cues.zh: 持怀疑态度的。

cues.en: They went, no, he's going to let gorse grow. You can't let gorse grow.
cues.zh: 他们抗议说：“不行，他居然要让荆豆疯长。你绝不能让荆豆长起来。”

cues.en: I come from a rural background.
cues.zh: 我出身农家。

cues.en: Gorse is a weed. You get rid of gorse. You burn it, you poison it, you bulldoze it, but you get rid of gorse.
cues.zh: 荆豆就是杂草。你得除掉它。放火烧、打农药、用推土机铲，无论如何你都得把荆豆除掉。

cues.en: Gorse is a terrible, terrible weed for pastoral farming. It's shocking. And no
cues.zh: Gorse 对畜牧业来说是一种非常糟糕、非常糟糕的杂草。太可怕了。而且没有

cues.en: one, let alone me, would deny that.
cues.zh: 没有人会否认这一点，更不用说我了。

cues.en: But it's also... Almost nothing is black and white, is it? If you've got it and it's sort of infested
cues.zh: 但事情也……几乎没什么是黑白分明的，对吧？如果你已经拥有了它，而它又有点被侵染了

cues.en: the landscape irretrievably,
cues.zh: 不可逆转地改变了整个格局，

cues.en: in a way, it's worth looking at its good points and seeing, well, maybe we don't have to fight it.
cues.zh: 某种程度上，值得看看它的优点，想想也许我们不必与它对抗。

cues.en: On this marginal hill country, fighting it usually makes it worse because that's what gorse thrives on. So we said, no, we're just gonna leave the gorse alone on this gorse infested pasture. We don't want pasture, we want native forest to regenerate, and gorse is a wonderful nurse canopy for native forest regeneration.
cues.zh: 在这片贫瘠的山地，跟金雀花较劲通常只会让情况更糟，因为这正是它疯长喜欢的。所以我们就说，算了，这片长满金雀花的牧场，就随它去吧。我们不要牧场，我们要让原生林再生，而金雀花是原生林再生极好的保育冠层。

cues.en: It's an opportunistic plant. It takes advantage of cleared ground and forest climates,
cues.zh: 它是一种机会性植物。它能充分利用清理出的空地和森林气候，

cues.en: but it can't stand
cues.zh: 但这站不住脚

cues.en: shade. It has to have full sunlight.
cues.zh: 遮阴。它必须要有充足的阳光。

cues.en: So as soon as it's shaded, it's dead.
cues.zh: 所以只要被阴影遮挡，它就死了。

cues.en: So it grows quite fast in the full light, but then other things come in underneath it naturally.
cues.zh: 它在充足光照下长得很快，但随后其他植物自然就会在它下面长起来。

cues.en: Shade tolerant hardwood trees, for example, and they just thrive under the gorse shelter. The gorse is a nitrogen fixer, so it's actually fertilizing the soil all the time with nitrates, a very important nutrient for plant life.
cues.zh: 比如耐阴的硬木树，它们就在荆豆的庇护下茁壮生长。荆豆能固氮，所以它其实一直在用硝酸盐给土壤施肥，而硝酸盐是植物生命非常重要的一种养分。

cues.en: This is old man gorse here with a few natives. Often it's thicker than this, sometimes it's thinner than this, but eventually
cues.zh: 这位是老曼戈斯，还有几个当地人。通常比这更茂密，有时比这更稀疏，但最终

cues.en: all these natives come up under here. The one that's probably the most abundant one of all is mahoi or whitey wood, which we can see here.
cues.zh: 这些本地树种都在这里生长。最常见的可能是 mahoi，也叫 whitey wood，我们在这里就能看到。

cues.en: It thrives under the shade, but once it gets its head up, it loves the sun as well. So as soon as the head's up above the...
cues.zh: 它在阴凉下长得好，但一旦冒头，也喜欢阳光。所以一旦它的头探出……

cues.en: Into the light, it's shading the gorse and the gorse dies.
cues.zh: 伸进光里后，它给荆豆遮阴，荆豆就死了。

cues.en: As all these lower parts of the gorse is all dead because it's shaded.
cues.zh: 荆豆下部全都死了，因为被遮阴了。

cues.en: I initially thought that the progression from gorse to native trees would take fifty years, but in ten years,
cues.zh: 我起初以为从荆豆到本土树的演替要五十年，但十年间，

cues.en: you could see it. You could see them coming up through the course in areas that I didn't I didn't realize that there would be native growing.
cues.zh: 你就能看出来了。你能看到它们从荆豆丛中长出来，就在我没想到会有本土植物生长的区域。

cues.en: And, of course, you're not getting pasture back, but you're getting native forest back with all its benefits, increased benefits now with carbon sequestration as well as all the ecological and biodiversity values that are being fostered this way.
cues.zh: 当然，你收回来的不是牧场，而是本土森林，带着它所有的好处；现在还有碳封存带来的额外收益，以及用这种方式培育出的生态和生物多样性价值。

cues.en: Our whole philosophy is what I call minimal interference management.
cues.zh: 我们的整套理念，就是我所说的最小干预管理。

cues.en: People
cues.zh: 人们

cues.en: have an inflated opinion of
cues.zh: 对……估计过高

cues.en: what Homo sapiens is capable of.
cues.zh: 智人到底能做到什么。

cues.en: I hate to say this because I'm a Homo sapiens as well.
cues.zh: 我不想这么说，因为我也是智人。

cues.en: But we're really good at damaging things. We're not all that good at putting things right.
cues.zh: 但我们很擅长破坏东西，却不太擅长把东西修复好。

cues.en: But all the serious work of natural regeneration of native forest and wildlife is being done by nature.
cues.zh: 但让本土森林和野生动物自然再生，这些真正的重活都是大自然在干。

cues.en: People say to us, oh you're planting all this forest back?
cues.zh: 人们对我们说，哦，你们要把这片森林都种回来吗？

cues.en: And and it's a sensible sounding question. But really if we were planting
cues.zh: 这问题听起来挺合理。但说真的，如果我们要种回

cues.en: this forest back, we'd never do it. On 1,500 hectares of land of wild,
cues.zh: 这片森林，我们根本不会去做。在1500公顷的荒野、

cues.en: hilly,
cues.zh: 多山、

cues.en: rough terrain, we'd never do it.
cues.zh: 崎岖地形上，我们根本不会去做。

cues.en: Nature has planted the forest back in totally ecologically appropriate
cues.zh: 大自然已经以完全符合生态规律

cues.en: and scientifically interesting ways.
cues.zh: 且颇具科学意义的方式，让森林重新生长起来。

cues.en: There's millions of hectares of productive farmland in New Zealand on good soils or on easy terrain.
cues.zh: 新西兰有数百万公顷肥沃的农田，土壤良好，地形也适合耕作。

cues.en: But then there's also, let's say, millions of hectares also
cues.zh: 但除此之外，也有数百万公顷

cues.en: in marginal hill country that are not actually that productive, but with our farming ethic, we sort of think it's clear to forest we should keep farming it and producing food. Of course, we need to produce food. We all have to eat. So we're all dependent on the farms producing food. Perhaps we could be a bit more sensible, maybe eat a little bit less meat and make it more efficient and environmentally friendly.
cues.zh: 位于边缘丘陵地带的土地，实际产出并不高。但受农业伦理观念影响，我们总觉得，既然还能利用，就应该继续耕种、生产食物。当然，我们确实需要生产食物，毕竟每个人都要吃饭。所以，我们都依赖农场生产食物。或许我们可以更理性一些，比如少吃一点肉，让生产更高效，也更环保。

cues.en: But my idea,
cues.zh: 但我的想法是，

cues.en: even New Zealand wide,
cues.zh: 即使放眼整个新西兰，

cues.en: and particularly with the possibility of income now from this land is carbon sequestration,
cues.zh: 尤其是现在这类土地还能通过固碳获得收入，

cues.en: you stop trying to farm that land.
cues.zh: 我们也应该停止耕种这些土地。

cues.en: You don't even plant exotic forests on it for timber maybe, but certainly not for carbon sequestration.
cues.zh: 甚至不一定要在上面种植用于木材生产的人工林，更不该为了固碳而种。

cues.en: That's just replacing one ridiculous folly with another ridiculous folly.
cues.zh: 那只是用另一个荒谬的错误，替代原本的荒谬错误。

cues.en: The scene is wide open for taking this marginal gorse infested hill country
cues.zh: 如今，我们完全可以利用这片长满金雀花的边缘丘陵地带，

cues.en: and letting it just do what Hinawa is doing on a much grander scale and regenerating into native forest on its own. We don't have to plant this stuff. Nature's doing it. All we've got to do is take away the deleterious things that are stopping it happening fast.
cues.zh: 让它像 Hinawa 正在做的那样，只是规模大得多，自行恢复成原生森林。我们不需要种下这些树。大自然自己会完成这件事。我们要做的，只是移除那些阻碍它快速发生的不利因素。

cues.en: As well as sequestering carbon, you get all the other benefits.
cues.zh: 除了固碳，你还能获得所有其他好处。

cues.en: You get the huge biodiversity on which we're totally dependent as well. And we also share the world with all the other species that have evolved as well. That's a crucial thing we tend to forget about.
cues.zh: 你还能获得我们完全依赖的丰富生物多样性。我们也和其他所有进化而来的物种共享这个世界。这是我们常常忘记的关键一点。

cues.en: Got to be reasonably deep because we don't want it too higher.
cues.zh: 得相当深，因为我们不想让它太高。

cues.en: Where do you want it? In the middle.
cues.zh: 你想放哪儿？中间。

cues.en: Everything's done very slow here.
cues.zh: 这里一切都做得很慢。

cues.en: People walk. Paul and I will use a vehicle, but Hugh doesn't use a vehicle. He'll cycle or he'll walk.
cues.zh: 人们步行。保罗和我会用车，但休不用车。他要么骑车，要么步行。

cues.en: So he doesn't believe we should be using fossil fuels. And instead of saying, don't use fossil fuels, he just rides his bike. And he'll use public transport.
cues.zh: 所以他不认为我们应该使用化石燃料。他没有说“别用化石燃料”，而是直接骑自行车。他还会用公共交通。

cues.en: I'm a technological person like anyone in the modern world. I I have a house with electricity.
cues.zh: 我和现代世界的任何人一样是个懂技术的人。我有一栋通电的房子。

cues.en: My hot water is heated by the sun, by solar panels on the roof, but I don't have photovoltaic
cues.zh: 我的热水靠太阳加热，靠屋顶的太阳能板，但我这里没有光伏

cues.en: cells to create electricity here, and we are on a national grid here. So that's quite a big technological thing.
cues.zh: 电池来发电，我们这里接的是国家电网。所以那是个相当大的技术设施。

cues.en: I have a landline telephone.
cues.zh: 我有座机电话。

cues.en: I don't have a cell phone. It wouldn't be putting us anywhere because we're out of cell phone range here. Thank goodness. Thank heavens.
cues.zh: 我没有手机。有也没用，因为我们这里不在手机信号覆盖范围内。谢天谢地。感谢上天。

cues.en: I'm not against all this technology. I'm not anti it, but I don't want it.
cues.zh: 我并不反对所有这些技术。我不反它，但我并不想要它。

cues.en: I'm very happy with,
cues.zh: 我对我这里拥有的

cues.en: with the level of technology I have here.
cues.zh: 技术水平非常满意。

cues.en: I do see, unfortunately, that uncritical acceptance of a lot of this technology. We're losing a lot of our old skills and
cues.zh: 不幸的是，我确实看到，人们对许多这类技术不加批判地接受。我们正在失去许多旧技能，以及

cues.en: artistic and creative satisfaction.
cues.zh: 艺术和创造上的满足感。

cues.en: I I really do feel that quite strongly. So I'm not in a sort of mood to just roll with the tide and take on all this technology, which I think is unnecessary for me and actually not all that good for the community,
cues.zh: 我真的有很强烈的感受。所以我不太想随波逐流，接受所有这些技术，我觉得这些技术对我没必要，而且对社区其实也不太好，

cues.en: to be honest.
cues.zh: 说实话。

cues.en: It has wonderful advantages as well. And some of the things that technology produces, I... I've been the first to play. I mean, the bicycle, for example, I regard as the peak of transport technology,
cues.zh: 它也有很棒的好处。技术产生的一些东西，我……我都是第一个去玩的。比如自行车，我认为它是交通技术的巅峰，

cues.en: and it's technology, and I love it.
cues.zh: 它就是技术，我很喜欢。

cues.en: I love my work here, and I meet
cues.zh: 我喜欢我在这里的工作，我遇到

cues.en: innumerable
cues.zh: 无数

cues.en: people here. I'm not a hermit.
cues.zh: 的人。我不是隐士。

cues.en: I
cues.zh: 我

cues.en: do interact with the rest of humanity for sure.
cues.zh: 确实会和人类其他部分互动。

cues.en: And love it.
cues.zh: 而且很喜欢。

cues.en: My roots are here. I I... Immense satisfaction from seeing what is happening here.
cues.zh: 我的根在这里。我……看到这里发生的一切，我感到极大的满足。

cues.en: Fire has always been our biggest fear, I'd say.
cues.zh: 我会说，火一直是我们最大的恐惧。

cues.en: we had a major lightning strike here.
cues.zh: 这里遭遇了一场严重的雷击。

cues.en: So that morning was terrible.
cues.zh: 那天早上很糟糕。

cues.en: We we actually saw the the thunderstorm come over. It was an almost
cues.zh: 我们确实看到雷暴过来了。那几乎是

cues.en: rainless thunderstorm in
cues.zh: 一场无雨的雷暴，在

cues.en: July.
cues.zh: 七月。

cues.en: It was the driest winter we've ever recorded.
cues.zh: 那是我们有记录以来最干燥的冬天。

cues.en: So the conditions were like summer like dry conditions here. And then this electrical storm come over, we saw the lightning strike come down, and it hit
cues.zh: 所以这里的情况就像夏天一样干燥。然后这场电暴过来了，我们看到闪电劈下来，击中了

cues.en: Full Moon Bluff across here on the high ridge,
cues.zh: 对面高脊上的 Full Moon Bluff，

cues.en: and it just exploded into flame.
cues.zh: 然后它就瞬间爆燃成火焰。

cues.en: We got... Had an immediate response. It was, I think, seven helicopters,
cues.zh: 我们……立刻做出了响应。我记得是七架直升机，

cues.en: and the helicopters could barely fly that first day because of the wind.
cues.zh: 第一天直升机因为风几乎飞不起来。

cues.en: So it largely just kept burning.
cues.zh: 所以它基本上就一直在烧。

cues.en: Firefighters said, look, we just don't know what it's gonna do overnight. So I packed up what I could.
cues.zh: 消防员说，看，我们不知道一夜之间它会怎么发展。所以我把能带的东西都打包了。

cues.en: It was at one of the worst moments of my life.
cues.zh: 那是我人生中最糟糕的时刻之一。

cues.en: And and was evacuated
cues.zh: 然后就被疏散了

cues.en: to Akaroa,
cues.zh: 到 Akaroa，

cues.en: jumped on my bike and rode to Akaroa.
cues.zh: 跳上自行车骑到了 Akaroa。

cues.en: In the morning, I woke up there, looked up, and the whole of Taraterehu,
cues.zh: 早上，我在那儿醒来，抬头一看，整个 Taraterehu，

cues.en: Stony Bay Peak, was just winged with fire.
cues.zh: Stony Bay Peak，都被火舌吞没了。

cues.en: And by that time, the wind had died down, and then the helicopters could fly,
cues.zh: 到那时候，风已经小了，直升机可以飞了，

cues.en: and they took monsoon
cues.zh: 他们一趟趟地

cues.en: bucket after monsoon bucket out of Putakitaki
cues.zh: 用吊桶从 Putakitaki

cues.en: Pond.
cues.zh: 池塘里取水。

cues.en: But the interesting thing was every time it was burning fast through gorse, every time it hit a bush edge or a generated native bush edge or even beach forest, older growth forest, just went out.
cues.zh: 但有意思的是，每次火在荆豆丛中快速蔓延时，一碰到灌木边缘，或者再生的原生灌木边缘，甚至是海滩森林、更古老的森林，火就自己灭了。

cues.en: So there was almost no native bush destroyed.
cues.zh: 所以几乎没有原生灌木被毁。

cues.en: Huge years of gorse with natives coming through, but was still largely gorse that was burning
cues.zh: 大片的荆豆丛里长着原生植物，但烧起来的主要还是荆豆

cues.en: hot and fast.
cues.zh: 又热又猛。

cues.en: So it burned, I think, for twenty seven hours.
cues.zh: 所以我想它烧了二十七个钟头。

cues.en: But it was very emotional for me. I came back the next morning to my house, found it still here.
cues.zh: 但对我来说情绪非常激动。第二天早上我回到我的房子，发现它还在。

cues.en: Fire was out.
cues.zh: 火已经灭了。

cues.en: This... The whole landscape in front of me was just blackened. It was just a complete nightmare.
cues.zh: 这……我面前的整片土地都烧黑了。简直就是一场彻头彻尾的噩梦。

cues.en: Yeah. I can still feel that emotion just almost leaping on me like a like a like a panther.
cues.zh: 是啊。我还能感觉到那种情绪几乎扑到我身上，像一只……像一只黑豹。

cues.en: I think the the community
cues.zh: 我觉得社区

cues.en: now by and large is
cues.zh: 现在大体上是

cues.en: absolutely in support of Hinawai.
cues.zh: 完全支持 Hinawai 的。

cues.en: We realized that the way farming was done over the years had to be changed
cues.zh: 我们意识到这些年来务农的方式必须改变

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: I think from what Hugh has done has helped people realise that
cues.zh: 我觉得从 Hugh 所做的一切帮助人们认识到

cues.en: it can be done in a good way.
cues.zh: 这是可以用好的方式做到的。

cues.en: I think it's a really interesting time to be involved in conservation.
cues.zh: 我觉得现在参与自然保护工作，时机真的很有意思。

cues.en: There's this great groundswell now of of people who are closing off whole gullies because it's uneconomical
cues.zh: 现在有一股很大的浪潮，人们把整条沟壑封起来，因为那些地不划算，

cues.en: land, so they're letting the bush grow back.
cues.zh: 所以就让灌木重新长回来。

cues.en: And they're fencing it off so that nature can be there, so that we can have these corridors, and so that the birds can move, and the insects can move, and things can can get from the summit to the sea, and and over the hills to the next one.
cues.zh: 他们把它围起来，让自然得以存在，让我们能拥有这些生态廊道，让鸟类可以移动，昆虫可以移动，让万物能从山顶到大海，翻过山丘到下一座山。

cues.en: Forestry alone won't save us from global warming because a lot of the sequestered carbon
cues.zh: 单靠林业救不了我们免受全球变暖影响，因为大量固存的碳

cues.en: is locked up in fossil fuels.
cues.zh: 都锁在化石燃料里。

cues.en: But even covering every inch of dry land in the world with forest wouldn't sequester enough if we keep on burning the fossil fuels that have been sequestered for millions of years.
cues.zh: 但即使把世界上每一寸旱地都种上森林，如果我们继续燃烧那些封存了数百万年的化石燃料，也固存不了足够的碳。

cues.en: So forest is definitely part of the solution, but not the whole part. We have to change our... The way we we use energy as well. In a big way, we have to do it very quickly or we're we're
cues.zh: 所以森林肯定是解决方案的一部分，但不是全部。我们还必须改变……我们使用能源的方式。而且要大规模地改，必须非常快地改，否则我们就

cues.en: really stuffed.
cues.zh: 真的完蛋了。

cues.en: No one person can solve these massive problems. So all you can do and all any... All the universe can expect of you is to do your best.
cues.zh: 没有哪一个人能解决这些庞大的问题。所以你能做的，以及任何……整个宇宙能对你期望的，就是尽力而为。

cues.en: Your best can be all sorts of different scales.
cues.zh: 你的尽力可以是各种不同的规模。

cues.en: We're doing our best here in terms of human life and the the ecology and biodiversity and climate and other species sharing the planet with us. All those things.
cues.zh: 我们在人类生活、生态与生物多样性、气候，以及与我们共享这颗星球的其他物种方面，都在尽力而为。所有这些都是。

cues.en: Plant for the birds, plant for the bees,
cues.zh: 为鸟儿种树，为蜜蜂种花，

cues.en: throw a few flowers in your garden. It doesn't have to be as big as
cues.zh: 在花园里撒几朵花。不必像

cues.en: So if people can look at Hinawa and say,
cues.zh: 所以如果人们看着 Hinawa 说，

cues.en: gosh, this is succeeding in lovely ways.
cues.zh: 天哪，这正以美好的方式取得成功。

cues.en: I'll do something in my own little corner of the world that draws some sort of inspiration from that. I'd I'd be delighted with that. It's never been our intention. Our intention was just to do the right thing in this corner of the world.
cues.zh: 我会在我自己的小角落里做点什么，从中汲取某种灵感。我会为此感到高兴。这从来不是我们的本意。我们的本意只是在这个世界的这个角落里做正确的事。

cues.en: But if that's repeated
cues.zh: 但如果这被重复

cues.en: over and over and over again, well,
cues.zh: 一遍又一遍又一遍，那么，

cues.en: the the
cues.zh: 这这

cues.en: possibilities are immense.
cues.zh: 可能性是巨大的。

cues.en: The problems are immense, but the solutions are immense too.
cues.zh: 问题巨大，但解决方案同样巨大。
